title: Skill Supply-Chain Scanner
tagline: Find risky instruction patterns with exact source evidence.
summary: Build an offline advisory scanner that preserves UTF-8 offsets, reports explicit policy patterns, scores distinct findings and emits a review gate. It is a transparent heuristic, not a malware detector or a promise that unflagged skills are safe.
usefulFor: A skill-change review assistant quoting newly introduced capabilities.
The scanner emits versioned JSON with file paths, exact UTF-8 byte spans and advisory rules.
youWillBuild: A skill-change review assistant quoting newly introduced capabilities.

stages.title: Retain byte-accurate source spans
stages.summary: Split UTF-8 source into numbered lines and retain exclusive byte offsets into the original buffer.

stages.title: Detect named advisory patterns
stages.summary: Rules inspect lowercase line text but report original offsets.

stages.title: Score distinct evidence without inflation
stages.summary: Count each rule once per source line even if a collector repeats a finding.

stages.title: Build an explicit review gate
stages.summary: A threshold crossing requests review; below threshold means only that these rules did not cross the configured threshold.
